london: ^Monsieur Phileas Fogg returned home early from the Reform Club, and in a new-fangled steam-carriage, besides!
^"Passepartout," said he. "We are going around the world!"
astonished: ^"You are in jest!" I told him in dignified affront. "You make mock of me, Monsieur."
nod: ^I nodded curtly, not believing a word of it.
leave: ^I turned and began to walk away, this man was clearly outside of his mind.
^However, as I did so, Monsier Fogg called out and spoke words that caught my attention and stopped me in my tracks.
ending: ^"We shall circumnavigate the globe within eighty days." He was quite calm as he proposed this wild scheme. "We leave for Paris on the 8:25. In an hour."

b: ^ This was going to be a wild ride.
